messages.text: back. quick one on the search page before i lose focus
finally!! was about to write a mock api 😭 how do we want it to feel
aspiration search. type what you want to learn. hits people who have done it, are figuring it out, or just considering it
ohh nice so its not just matching interests but intents? that sounds way better for the demo
exactly. key constraint: read path is fast. exact match then trigram fuzzy only. we never block on the LLM during a search query
got it so if i type something new it might not show anything until the worker catches up?
yep. if its a brand new string, it resolves in the background. you need to tell them 'resolving...' and maybe retry after like 5s? or just show empty state with a hint
i can do a spinner + 'figuring out where this fits'. feels friendlier than a blank page
perfect. api shape: /search/aspiration?q=... returns groups by stance. keys are 'mastered', 'learning', 'considering'. each has a list of people + the matched concept name
wait does the response include the confidence score too? or is that internal?
no, keep it clean. just the concept name and person id. we rank internally by idf + stance weight. frontend just renders what comes back
makes sense. so i don't have to do any scoring logic in react? thank god
correct. just a list render. i'll stub the endpoint tomorrow morning so you can hit it with dummy data first
you are a lifesaver. i hate writing fake json by hand 🙄
lol same. i'll also add a query param to force the 'resolving' state so you can test that flow without waiting for the worker
YES please. testing latency is the worst part of frontend dev imo
agreed. going to bed now. ping me if the api shape is ambiguous
night! gonna start the layout then 👋
